blog_title: Royal Blue vs Navy T-Shirt Colour Difference — ₹45K Bulk Order Cancelled Over 1 Shade
caption:
₹8 polybag skipped. 600 t-shirts destroyed by fungus in 4 days. 😬

Monsoon humidity hits 80-90%. Cotton absorbs moisture fast. Black fungus spreads piece to piece in bundles—one skip costs you the entire stock.

We've seen ₹40k orders go bad because someone thought polybag packing was optional.

Solution: ₹5-8 polybag + silica gel per piece. Cartons on pallets, never the floor.

Save this if you're sourcing bulk tees before monsoon 👇
